excluded: remote writes that touch one silo only

USER_IP_EVENT (UserIP), ORGAUTHTOKEN_UPDATE_USED (OrgAuthToken.date_last_used), ISSUE_COMMENT_UPDATE (email reply writes a cell comment), unsubscribe, Slack default organization, identity token refresh, GCP connection check, SCM repository sync and migration tasks, ServiceHook project settings, Teams uninstall, SSO unlink email
SENTRY_APP_UPDATE, SENTRY_APP_INSTALLATION_UPDATE, cache clearing in USER_UPDATE, non-delete messages of INTEGRATION_UPDATE and API_APPLICATION_UPDATE
ProjectKey update (ProjectKeyMapping copies only public_key); Identity delete (no cross-silo child tables); update messages of OrganizationIntegration and Team (empty handlers)
migration, relocation, backup and CLI tooling
SCM_INTEGRATION_CONFIG_BACKFILL, relocation, backup, createuser, merge_users commands
deprecated, or producer not in the open-source code
DISABLE_AUTH_PROVIDER, ORGANIZATION_MAPPING_CUSTOMER_ID_UPDATE, POST_ORGANIZATION_PROVISION, SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATE, PARTNER_ACCOUNT_UPDATE, SEND_VERCEL_INVOICE, FTC_CONSENT
copies: Mapping[organization_id, slug, name, status, 9 flags, date_created] ⊆ Organization[id, …]
Mapping[organizationmember_id, organization_id, role, user_id, email, inviter_id, invite_status] ⊆ Member[id, …]
copied columns user_id, inviter_id also carry FKs to User (implied by transitivity)
Replica[apikey_id, organization_id, label, key, status, allowed_origins, scope_list] ⊆ ApiKey[id, …]
replica table deliberately has no unique constraint on key ("to simplify replication")
Replica[apitoken_id, user_id, application_id, organization, token, hashed_token, expires_at, scope_list, …] ⊆ ApiToken[id, …]
application_is_active is a value derived via ApiApplication, not in K
Replica[orgauthtoken_id, organization, token_hashed, name, scope_list, created_by_id, date_deactivated] ⊆ OrgAuthToken[id, …]
Replica[auth_provider_id, organization_id, provider, config, default_role, default_global_access, scim_enabled, allow_unlinked] ⊆ AuthProvider[id, …]
Replica[auth_identity_id, user_id, auth_provider_id, ident, data, last_verified] ⊆ AuthIdentity[id, …]
Member[user_id, user_email, user_is_active] ⊆ User[id, email, is_active]
Replica[organization_id, avatar_type, avatar_ident] ⊆ OrganizationAvatar[organization_id, avatar_type, ident]
references the non-primary unique key organization_id
ServiceHook[installation_id, url, events] copies SentryApp[webhook_url, events] via SentryAppInstallation.sentry_app
two-hop path copy, not a single IND
Reservation[organization_id, slug] ⊆ Organization[id, slug], PRIMARY rows only
derived: one-way: linked => AuthIdentity exists; validity comes from the external IdP
derived: privilege <=> membership in the privileged team (SaaS superuser organization only)
